sentences.text: It has been informed by learned Additional Advocate General appearing for the State that the petitioner is not cooperating in the ongoing investigation and he has also not surrendered his Passport in spite of request made by the Investigating Officer.
Considering the above, we do not think that this is a case where indulgence of this Court is required.
The Special Leave Petition is, accordingly, dismissed.
Pending interlocutory application(s), if any, is/are disposed of.
